description: Rules for all SupportIQ requirements analysis and documentation activities.
applyTo: "docs/requirements/**/*.md"

# SupportIQ Requirements Rules

- Treat baseline documents as initial inputs, not approved requirements.
- Never silently invent or assume requirements.
- Clearly distinguish confirmed, proposed, assumed and unresolved items.
- Assign stable IDs to requirements.
- Maintain source references and decision evidence.
- Ask stakeholders one question at a time during discovery.
- Preserve the original baseline document.
- Keep analysis, evidence and approved documents separate.
- Do not mark requirements approved without explicit stakeholder approval.
- Do not begin implementation planning until requirements approval.
- Maintain traceability between requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and tests.
